findings.title: Israeli strike on southern Gaza hospital kills four, Gaza civil defence says
findings.location: Nasser Hospital, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: At least four people reportedly killed and several wounded in an airstrike on a building at Nasser Hospital, according to Gaza Civil Defence spokesman quoted by Reuters. Victim identities and civilian/combatant status unverified; building function, structural damage, clinical service interruption and operational capacity impacts unverified.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: killed at least four people and wounded several others early on Thursday

bounded_discovery_context.discovery_method: Targeted Reuters search after OCHA OPT and WHO official checks; article opened and its source dateline and publication timestamp checked.
bounded_discovery_context.source_timestamp_basis: Reuters article states 'November 11, 2026 11:26 PM UTC'; 15:26 PST, after prior heartbeat completion at 14:47:22 PST.
bounded_discovery_context.new_information: Distinct reported strike on hospital building in Khan Younis early Thursday 12 November (Palestinian local time) with at least four fatalities and several injuries, not earlier Wednesday Gaza City incidents.
bounded_discovery_context.overlap_warning: Do not add this to the prior November 11 Gaza City four-fatality local update without per-incident reconciliation. Geography and event date distinguish the new report; identity and casualty list not independently verified.
bounded_discovery_context.independent_confirmation: Not found within the bounded twelve additional targeted searches; Reuters attributes incident to Gaza Civil Defence spokesman; Israeli military did not immediately comment.
bounded_discovery_context.timing_limit: Event time given only as 'early Thursday' in Gaza; exact minute, whether patients/staff were among casualties, and facility service impact unknown.
bounded_discovery_context.qualification: High-value new reported casualties and direct strike involving a hospital facility; supplementary watch finding, not production publication or approval.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary bounded Gaza recall only. Production collector and daily publisher remain authoritative.
